title: kate-ui: paint the tab bar and switch tabs
summary: The window paints one tab per TabRow above the editor. A click activates that view. cmd-shift-] and cmd-shift-[ move to the next and the previous tab. The active view of the window follows Workspace::active_view instead of one fixed ViewId.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// Index of the tab `delta` steps from `active`, wrapping around. `count` 0 returns 0.
fn next_tab_index(active: usize, count: usize, delta: i32) -> usize

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Render a tab row above the editor from tabs::tab_rows. The active tab uses the selection color; a modified tab shows a dot before its title. A click on a tab calls Workspace::activate and then show_view. Bind cmd-shift-] to NextTab and cmd-shift-[ to PreviousTab and add both to a new View menu. next_tab_index adds delta to active modulo count. WindowRoot::view follows workspace.active_view after every file request and tab switch. The test next_tab_index_wraps_around asserts (0, 3, 1) is 1, (2, 3, 1) is 0, (0, 3, -1) is 2, and (0, 0, 1) is 0. The owner checks that three open files show three tabs and that the keys switch them. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::next_tab_index_wraps_around
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because next_tab_index does not exist. After the change the index wraps in both directions and an empty bar stays at 0.
